case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Verified authority for standing account actions, protected student identity and meaningful assessment oversight.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: N077 (1.6) only prohibits sharing passwords with 'any other person' and N087 (6.3.1) only prohibits unauthorised AI-produced submissions post-hoc; neither verifies authority for standing AI agent account actions nor ensures meaningful per-semester assessment oversight.
case_summary.case_note: Murdoch's Digital and Technology Conditions of Use Policy (N077, 1.6) requires authorised account access and bars password disclosure to another person, while N087 (6.3.1) prohibits submitting AI-produced work without assessment authorisation. However, Murdoch policies do not address standing autonomous AI-agent delegation under a student's own credentials or establish meaningful pre-submission oversight, leaving a critical gap. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15, and this proposal awaits human verification.
